definitions.explanation: An organized social or public gathering.
Activities or performances held for enjoyment.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{催|もよお}し⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参加|さんか}した→参加：02498_sanka⟧。
examples.english: I participated in a local event.

examples.english: Various entertainments are held at the summer festival.

notes:
{催|もよお}し is the noun form of the verb {催|もよお}す (to hold/organize an event), referring to organized events or gatherings.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {催|もよお}しに{参加|さんか}する (to participate in an event)
- {催|もよお}しを{開|ひら}く (to hold an event)
- {催|もよお}しの{案内|あんない} (event announcement)

COMPOUNDS:
- {催|もよお}し{物|もの}: Event, entertainment, show
- {催|もよお}し{会場|かいじょう}: Event venue

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {催|もよお}し vs. イベント: イベント is the loanword commonly used; {催|もよお}し is more traditional/formal Japanese.
- {催|もよお}し vs. {行事|ぎょうじ}: {行事|ぎょうじ} refers to regular or traditional events (school events, ceremonies); {催|もよお}し is broader and includes entertainment.

Register: Neutral to slightly formal. {催|もよお}し{物|もの} (entertainments) is common in formal announcements.
